quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ
وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

parent_channels.name: Celestial Concealment and Renewal

subchannels.name: Wound Sun and Falling Stars
subchannels.scene_or_process: Solar radiance is gathered and rolled while stars rush downward in a scattered fall.
subchannels.active_motifs: solar disk (`ش م س:B001/m01`); winding and gathering (`ك و ر:B001/m01`); rising stars (`ن ج م:B001/m01`); plunging, scattered motion (`ك د ر:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The sun is treated as light that can be wound into itself, while the stars move from ordered appearance to rapid, dispersed collapse.

subchannels.name: Planets Retreating into Stations
subchannels.scene_or_process: Moving celestial bodies withdraw from sight and enter their concealed lodgings.
subchannels.active_motifs: planets that hide or reverse (`خ ن س:B002/m01`); celestial running (`ج ر ي:B001/m01`); stars hidden in their courses (`ك ن س:B003/m01`); disappearance from sight (`غ ي ب:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Running, retreat, and entry into a hidden station form one astronomical cycle rather than three unrelated motions.

subchannels.name: The Thinning Edge of Night
subchannels.scene_or_process: Darkness covers the scene, then thins at one of the two margins of night.
subchannels.active_motifs: night and its darkness (`ل ي ل:B001/m01`); darkness at nightfall or withdrawal (`ع س ع س:B001/m01`); night covering what lies beneath it (`ج ن ن:B002/m01`); low cloud approaching the earth at night (`ع س ع س:B003/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The night is an active cover whose approach and recession are both encoded in the liminal motion of `عسعس`.

subchannels.name: Dawn Breathing Open
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dawn expands as though taking breath and spreading into available space.
subchannels.active_motifs: first light (`ص ب ح:B001/m01`); dawn opening like a breath (`ن ف س:B009/m01`); spreading and unfolding (`ن ش ر:B001/m02`).
subchannels.synthesis: Breath supplies the mechanism for daybreak: constriction releases, light extends, and the horizon becomes newly open.

subchannels.name: The Sky as a Stripped Canopy
subchannels.scene_or_process: An overhead cover is lifted away, exposing lights and ordered celestial structures behind it.
subchannels.active_motifs: sky as what rises and shades (`س م و:B004/m01`); removal of a covering (`ك ش ط:B001/m01`); raised canopy (`ع ر ش:B002/m01`); lamp or celestial light (`ص ب ح:B005/m01`); constellation called a throne (`ع ر ش:B008/m01`); motes visible in a sunbeam (`س ع ر:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The surface image of a peeled sky develops into an architectural scene in which a roof-like layer is removed and the lights and star-patterns beyond it become visible.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Celestial visibility changes through wrapping, falling, retreat, darkness, exposure, and renewed light.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The celestial sequence extends into hiding places, lamps, constellations, and an overhead canopy physically peeled away.

parent_channels.name: Distance, Orientation, and Shelter

subchannels.name: Horizon, Boundary, and Landmark
subchannels.scene_or_process: A distant edge is made navigable by a conspicuous marker or raised standard.
subchannels.active_motifs: remote horizon and boundary (`ء ف ق:B001/m01`); distinguishing landmark (`ع ل م:B002/m01`); prominent marker (`ن ج م:B006/m01`); visible standard (`ر ء ي:B011/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Distance becomes legible when an elevated or conspicuous sign fixes the edge of the field of view.

subchannels.name: Separation, Remoteness, and Depth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Connected things part, and the widening interval becomes a measurable remoteness or depth.
subchannels.active_motifs: separation after contact (`ب ي ن:B001/m01`); deep or wide interval (`ب ي ن:B006/m01`); broad expanse (`ب ح ر:B002/m01`); remoteness (`ش ط ن:B001/m01`); long measuring rope (`ش ط ن:B002/m01`); spatial breadth and respite (`ن ف س:B015/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Parting is rendered spatially as an interval that can deepen, lengthen, and require a rope or extended span to traverse.

subchannels.name: Middle Ground and Lateral Position
subchannels.scene_or_process: A participant occupies an intermediate strip or a side position relative to a route, settlement, animal, or working group.
subchannels.active_motifs: the interval between two sides (`ب ي ن:B002/m01`); intermediate condition (`ب ي ن:B011/m01`); settlements between desert and cultivated land (`ز ل ف:B005/m01`); outer or far side (`و ح ش:B003/m01`); lateral divergence (`ع ن د:B002/m01`); working from one side of an animal (`ب ي ن:B009/m01`); flank (`ء ف ق:B007/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: These motifs define orientation by relation to two edges: middle, near side, far side, and a sideward departure from the common line.

subchannels.name: Den, Copse, and Hidden Refuge
subchannels.scene_or_process: An animal or person enters a wooded or enclosed place that blocks outside sight.
subchannels.active_motifs: place of concealment (`ج ن ن:B017/m01`); deer and their shelter (`خ ن س:B004/m01`); entry into an animal den (`ك ن س:B002/m01`); concealing copse (`غ ي ب:B003/m01`); stone-lined animal refuge (`ر ج م:B005/m02`).
subchannels.synthesis: Vegetation, enclosure, and withdrawal cooperate as parts of one refuge scene rather than merely sharing the idea of invisibility.

subchannels.name: Concealment and Exposure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A covered object withdraws from sight, then becomes open when the covering is removed and the surface cleared.
subchannels.active_motifs: sensory concealment (`ج ن ن:B001/m01`); absence from sight (`غ ي ب:B001/m01`); withdrawal into hiding (`خ ن س:B001/m01`); stripping a cover (`ك ش ط:B001/m01`); sweeping a surface clear (`ك ن س:B001/m01`); open visibility (`ب ح ر:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Withdrawal and covering produce invisibility; stripping and sweeping reverse the operation until the object stands in open view.

subchannels.name: Abandoned and Barren Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: Loss of inhabitants, use, rain, and pasture turns a settled place into an empty waste.
subchannels.active_motifs: disuse and vacancy (`ع ط ل:B001/m01`); deserted ground (`و ح ش:B002/m01`); barren land (`ق و ي:B003/m01`); absence from sight (`غ ي ب:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Vacancy, desolation, failed productivity, and human absence define an environmental state distinct from active concealment.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Places are organized by visible limits, intervening distance, lateral orientation, and the availability or loss of cover.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same spatial vocabulary reaches from horizons and deep wells to animal dens, wooded refuges, flanks, and abandoned ground.

parent_channels.name: Waters, Wells, and Drinking

subchannels.name: Sea, Basin, and Collected Water
subchannels.scene_or_process: Abundant water gathers in a sea, low basin, or deep well until its container is full.
subchannels.active_motifs: broad abundant water (`ب ح ر:B001/m01`); water-collecting depression (`ب ح ر:B006/m01`); deep collected water (`ع ل م:B005/m01`); plentiful or sweet water (`ر ب ب:B013/m01`); filling with water (`س ج ر:B001/m01`); algae-covered surface (`ص ح ب:B007/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Sea, basin, and well are variants of one containment scene defined by breadth, depth, and the accumulation of water.

subchannels.name: The Well-and-Bucket Assembly
subchannels.scene_or_process: A filled bucket is lowered, steadied, raised, and shared at a wellhead.
subchannels.active_motifs: full bucket (`ذ ن ب:B007/m01`); superior bucket (`ء ف ق:B008/m01`); drinking down a common bucket (`ق و ي:B005/m01`); long bucket rope (`ش ط ن:B002/m01`); well weight and upright timbers (`ر ج م:B006/m01`); wooden well frame and drawing platform (`ع ر ش:B004/m01`); standing pulley component (`ق و م:B012/m01`); hard substrate that stops excavation (`ج ب ل:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs specify vessel, rope, counterweight, support, platform, and shared use, forming a concrete mechanical scene.

subchannels.name: Channels, Overflow, and Pouring
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water moves from a filled source through a channel and pours into lower ground.
subchannels.active_motifs: valley watercourse (`ذ ن ب:B004/m01`); flowing current (`ج ر ي:B001/m01`); overflowing fill (`س ج ر:B001/m01`); pouring (`ك د ر:B003/m01`); water-collecting lowland (`ب ح ر:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: A hydrological sequence connects source, channel, motion, discharge, and receiving basin.

subchannels.name: Draught, Refreshment, and Serving
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water or morning drink is taken in measured breaths and served from broad, filled vessels.
subchannels.active_motifs: a breath-sized draught (`ن ف س:B006/m01`); water that sustains life (`ن ف س:B008/m01`); return to the watering place (`ح ض ر:B003/m01`); morning drink (`ص ب ح:B003/m01`); broad dish or shallow pool (`ص ح ف:B004/m01`); filled bowls (`ز ل ف:B004/m01`); ladle (`ذ ن ب:B008/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The scene moves from water source to filled serving vessel, ladle, portioned draught, and bodily refreshment.

subchannels.name: Brine and Tempered Drink
subchannels.scene_or_process: A liquid's salinity or strength is altered by mixing it with water.
subchannels.active_motifs: seawater salinity (`ب ح ر:B004/m01`); dilution that breaks a drink's strength (`ق ت ل:B007/m01`); measured draught (`ن ف س:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Salty water and strong drink meet in a small chemistry of concentration, dilution, and drinkability.

subchannels.name: Seafaring and the Shipmaster
subchannels.scene_or_process: A vessel enters open water under a captain who directs its continuing course.
subchannels.active_motifs: embarkation and maritime affiliation (`ب ح ر:B009/m01`); chief of sailors (`ر ب ب:B017/m01`); flowing ship or current (`ج ر ي:B001/m01`); dispatch into motion (`ر س ل:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Open water, moving vessel, command, and dispatch create a complete voyage scene.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Water is gathered, conveyed, drawn, modified, served, and consumed through connected terrains and implements.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The water channel includes a complete well mechanism, brine and diluted drink, serving vessels, algae-covered pools, and maritime command.

parent_channels.name: Plant Growth and Cultivation

subchannels.name: Germination and Revived Herbage
subchannels.scene_or_process: Small spring growth emerges, thickens, and returns green after rain.
subchannels.active_motifs: stemless spring plant (`ن ج م:B003/m01`); dense rising vegetation (`ج ن ن:B011/m01`); herbage revived by rain (`ن ش ر:B004/m01`); persistent green plant (`ر ب ب:B012/m01`); spring herb (`م ك ن:B007/m01`); named plant (`ذ ن ب:B009/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Emergence, thickening, rain-revival, and named ground plants form one cycle of low vegetation.

subchannels.name: Orchard, Vine, and Trellis
subchannels.scene_or_process: Trees enclose a garden while vines climb supports and send hidden roots into the soil.
subchannels.active_motifs: tree-covered garden (`ج ن ن:B003/m01`); grapevine and fruit (`ك ر م:B004/m01`); vine trellis (`ع ر ش:B003/m01`); garden tree (`ع ش ر:B014/m01`); hidden roots (`غ ي ب:B008/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Enclosure, living vine, raised support, tree cover, and underground anchorage produce a worked orchard rather than a generic plant cluster.

subchannels.name: Palm Seedlings and Pollination
subchannels.scene_or_process: Young palms are propagated by using the male palm's flowering spadix.
subchannels.active_motifs: young palms (`ش ي ء:B006/m01`); young palms as a repeated lexical container (`ش ي ء:B008/m01`); male palm spadix used for pollination (`ع ط ل:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Seedling and pollen-bearing spadix supply both the plant and the horticultural operation required for palm propagation.

subchannels.name: Pasture, Night Grazing, and Stubble
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ripe pasture opens to flocks, which spread to graze and return over harvested ground.
subchannels.active_motifs: pasture ready for grazing (`ط و ع:B007/m01`); sheep dispersed at night (`ن ش ر:B006/m01`); activity during the night (`ل ي ل:B002/m01`); restraint from grazing (`ع ر ش:B010/m01`); successive flocks (`ر س ل:B005/m01`); herd of wild cattle (`ر ب ب:B014/m01`); crop remains after harvest (`ح ش ر:B008/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Readiness, release, flock movement, grazing control, and post-harvest residue define a pastoral field scene.

subchannels.name: Fertile Rain, Withering, and Renewal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rain-bearing cloud makes soil productive, while dry wood and hidden roots preserve the possibility of return.
subchannels.active_motifs: fertile land and rain (`ك ر م:B002/m01`); rainfall (`ذ ه ب:B005/m01`); rain cloud (`ر ب ب:B008/m01`); sky or cloud as rain source (`س م و:B004/m02`); dry tree (`ج ب ل:B008/m01`); buried roots (`غ ي ب:B008/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The channel holds drought and fertility together through a causal sequence of dry plant, rain cloud, productive earth, and surviving root.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Vegetation emerges, thickens, is tended or supported, feeds animals, and renews after rain or harvest.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The botanical channel reaches precise practices such as trellising vines, pollinating palms, grazing stubble, and exposing hidden roots.

parent_channels.name: Motion, Travel, and Pursuit

subchannels.name: Galloping Horse with Lifted Tail
subchannels.scene_or_process: A prized horse is driven at speed, lifts its tail, veers, and strikes the ground.
subchannels.active_motifs: splendid horse (`ء ف ق:B004/m01`); driving a mount to run (`ح ض ر:B004/m01`); veering in a gallop (`خ ن س:B005/m01`); raised tail in running (`ك و ر:B010/m01`); animal tail (`ذ ن ب:B002/m01`); rapid circling run (`س ع ر:B007/m01`); mounted rider (`ع ر ش:B011/m01`); smooth hairless hoof surface (`ك ن س:B004/m01`); hoof striking ground (`ر ج م:B008/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Breed quality, acceleration, tail posture, lateral movement, hoof surface, and impact create a detailed equestrian action sequence.

subchannels.name: Caravan and Herd Gait
subchannels.scene_or_process: Animals move in ordered groups with easy joints, successive files, and a steady intermediate gait.
subchannels.active_motifs: overland travel (`س ي ر:B001/m01`); travelling caravan (`س ي ر:B006/m01`); easy gait (`ر س ل:B003/m01`); group following group (`ر س ل:B005/m01`); continuous herd movement (`س ج ر:B008/m01`); animals lacking tack (`ع ط ل:B003/m01`); gathered herd (`ك و ر:B003/m01`); heavy footfall (`و ء د:B003/m01`); animal stopping from fatigue (`ق و م:B016/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The scene coordinates formation, gait, equipment state, and succession rather than treating every movement word as simple travel.

subchannels.name: Race, Rivalry, and Hunt
subchannels.scene_or_process: Competitors run alongside one another while hunters and raptors pursue quarry.
subchannels.active_motifs: running abreast (`ح ض ر:B005/m01`); keeping pace (`ج ر ي:B007/m01`); competitive matching (`س م و:B007/m01`); mutual visibility of opponents (`ر ء ي:B004/m01`); departure for the hunt (`س م و:B006/m01`); nocturnal prowling (`ع س ع س:B002/m01`); falcon or hawk (`ع ل م:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Matching speed, visual confrontation, nocturnal tracking, and the hunting bird form a pursuit frame with both human and animal participants.

subchannels.name: Departure Across the Horizons
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler sets out through distant regions, leaving a former place as fear falls away.
subchannels.active_motifs: travel through remote regions (`ء ف ق:B002/m01`); going away (`ذ ه ب:B006/m01`); overland movement (`س ي ر:B001/m01`); entering mountain country (`ج ب ل:B006/m01`); removal or expulsion (`س ي ر:B005/m01`); fear departing (`ك ش ط:B004/m01`); throwing off weight to escape (`و ح ش:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Movement is an exit process: range opens ahead, burdens are cast off, and the traveler leaves both place and panic behind.

subchannels.name: Flow and Dispatch
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water, people, or messages are released into motion and arrive in a running or scattered stream.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing course (`ج ر ي:B001/m01`); sending into motion (`ر س ل:B001/m01`); scattered arrival (`ك د ر:B004/m01`); clods raised by passing movement (`ك د ر:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Release supplies the cause, running supplies the course, and scattered arrival and raised ground mark the passage.

subchannels.name: Customary Route and Method
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repeated conduct settles into a recognized way of proceeding.
subchannels.active_motifs: established manner (`ج ر ي:B002/m01`); customary way (`س ي ر:B002/m01`); route or method (`ذ ه ب:B007/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Habit, customary conduct, and named route are three scales of the same stabilization of movement into method.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bodies and groups move through directed travel, running, pursuit, dispatch, and patterned routes.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The motion vocabulary reconstructs horse handling, caravan gait, races, hunting, and the formation of customary routes.

parent_channels.name: Material Transformation and Adornment

subchannels.name: Hide, Pelt, and Tanning
subchannels.scene_or_process: An animal skin is stripped, left with or without hair, cut into thongs, and treated with measured tanning material.
subchannels.active_motifs: hide under treatment (`ء ف ق:B005/m01`); hide-processing liquor (`ء ف ق:B006/m01`); small tanning dose (`ن ف س:B007/m01`); hair-on pelt (`ص ح ب:B006/m01`); skinning (`ك ش ط:B002/m01`); removed hide covering meat (`ك ش ط:B003/m01`); leather thong (`س ي ر:B003/m01`); dressing compound (`ر ب ب:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The scene preserves successive craft states: removal, hair retention, cutting, dosing, and chemical dressing.

subchannels.name: Woven, Striped, Folded, and Bundled Cloth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cloth is tightly woven, marked with linear bands, folded, wrapped, and bundled for carrying.
subchannels.active_motifs: finished weaving (`ج ب ل:B007/m01`); stripe-like bands (`س ي ر:B004/m01`); first fold of a garment (`ق س م:B007/m01`); clothing bundle (`ك و ر:B007/m01`); wrapped garment (`ك و ر:B008/m01`); howdah drape (`ز و ج:B006/m01`); identifying textile mark (`ع ل م:B002/m03`).
subchannels.synthesis: Weave, stripe, fold, wrapper, carrying bundle, and drape occupy successive roles in one textile-production and use scene.

subchannels.name: Mine, Gold, and Gilding
subchannels.scene_or_process: Mineral is extracted from a stony source, separated as gold, and applied as a surface coating.
subchannels.active_motifs: mine or mineral source (`ن ج م:B008/m01`); gold ore or nugget (`ذ ه ب:B001/m01`); stony mass (`ر ج م:B005/m01`); mountain material (`ج ب ل:B001/m01`); gilding or gold plating (`ذ ه ب:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Provenance, stone matrix, extracted metal, and coating form a continuous material transformation from mine to finished surface.

subchannels.name: Clay Forge and Driven Heat
subchannels.scene_or_process: A clay forge receives directed air so that fuel and metal reach working heat.
subchannels.active_motifs: clay smith's forge (`ك و ر:B013/m01`); breath as driven airflow (`ن ف س:B001/m02`); ignition (`س ع ر:B001/m01`); stoked fire (`س ج ر:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Enclosure, airflow, kindling, and intensified heat yield a compact blacksmithing mechanism.

subchannels.name: Necklace, Pendant, and Bare Neck
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pendants and beads are arranged around a neck that may be adorned, collared, or left bare.
subchannels.active_motifs: necklace pendants (`ش م س:B004/m01`); strung necklace (`ك ر م:B003/m01`); neck without ornament (`ع ط ل:B002/m01`); collar or yoke (`س ج ر:B009/m01`); continuous stringing (`س ج ر:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Ornament, string, neck, and constraining collar organize a precise adornment scene with an explicit adorned/unadorned contrast.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Raw hide, fiber, metal, and mineral are transformed through stripping, tanning, folding, heating, coating, and ornamentation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Several sparse constructions assemble complete crafts: leather preparation, patterned textiles, mining and gilding, a fired forge, and necklace work.

parent_channels.name: Authoritative Message and Remembrance

subchannels.name: Trusted Messenger at the Throne
subchannels.scene_or_process: A noble, powerful, established, obeyed, and trusted messenger carries an authoritative utterance.
subchannels.active_motifs: spoken utterance (`ق و ل:B001/m01`); messenger and message (`ر س ل:B002/m01`); honor (`ك ر م:B001/m01`); strength (`ق و ي:B001/m01`); proximity (`ع ن د:B004/m01`); royal throne (`ع ر ش:B001/m01`); established rank (`م ك ن:B004/m01`); obedience (`ط و ع:B001/m01`); trustworthiness (`ء م ن:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Speech, bearer, rank, power, reception, and reliability form a complete institutional transmission scene.

subchannels.name: Dispatch and Carried Speech
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker releases a message that a designated carrier conveys and explains to recipients.
subchannels.active_motifs: dispatch (`ر س ل:B001/m01`); bearer of a message (`ر س ل:B002/m01`); articulated saying (`ق و ل:B001/m01`); clarification of meaning (`ب ي ن:B005/m01`); public mention (`ذ ك ر:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Sender, carrier, verbal content, clarification, and reception distinguish message transmission from mere speech.

subchannels.name: Unfolded Scroll and Published Record
subchannels.scene_or_process: Written sheets are opened, gathered as a codex, or issued as a publicly readable record.
subchannels.active_motifs: written sheet (`ص ح ف:B002/m01`); collected codex (`ص ح ف:B003/m01`); opening a text (`ن ش ر:B001/m01`); published document (`ن ش ر:B009/m01`); certificate of right (`ذ ك ر:B008/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Material sheet, compilation, unfolding, publication, and certification trace the life of a written record.

subchannels.name: Recollection and Reminder
subchannels.scene_or_process: Knowledge held in memory is re-presented through mention, reminder, and instruction.
subchannels.active_motifs: recollection after forgetting (`ذ ك ر:B003/m01`); reminder or mnemonic prompt (`ذ ك ر:B009/m01`); knowing (`ع ل م:B001/m01`); attendance to what is brought forward (`ح ض ر:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Internal retention, renewed presence, explicit reminder, and recognition make remembrance an active retrieval process.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A message acquires authority through its sender, trustworthy bearer, articulated content, written preservation, and capacity to be recalled.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The message channel extends from oral delivery to documentary certificates and mnemonic prompts without collapsing them into one medium.

parent_channels.name: Language, Reference, and Text

subchannels.name: Articulation, Clarification, and Translation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech is produced by the tongue, made explicit, and transferred into another language.
subchannels.active_motifs: articulated speech (`ق و ل:B001/m01`); tongue as speech organ (`ق و ل:B002/m01`); clarification (`ب ي ن:B005/m01`); translation (`ر ج م:B009/m01`); mention on the tongue (`ذ ك ر:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Production, organ, explication, translation, and mention form a layered account of how meaning becomes communicable.

subchannels.name: Naming, Deixis, and Proper Designation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker assigns a name, points to a referent, and distinguishes proper names from descriptive location.
subchannels.active_motifs: naming and appellation (`س م و:B005/m01`); demonstrative pointer (`ذ و و:B003/m01`); interrogative or relative `ماذا` (`ذ و و:B004/m01`); named locality (`ء ف ق:B009/m01`); proper name `عسعس` (`ع س ع س:B004/m01`); names derived from the sun (`ش م س:B007/m01`); personal name `ليلى` (`ل ي ل:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Naming fixes identity, deixis locates it in discourse, and eponyms convert ordinary lexical material into a person or place.

subchannels.name: Grammar, Supposition, and Modality
subchannels.scene_or_process: Grammatical forms encode case behavior, approximation, quantity, and a proposition treated as supposition.
subchannels.active_motifs: inflectable noun (`م ك ن:B006/m01`); particle of approximation or quantity (`ر ب ب:B015/m01`); verb of supposition (`ق و ل:B011/m01`); relative `ذو` (`ذ و و:B002/m01`); intermediate phonological form (`ب ي ن:B011/m02`).
subchannels.synthesis: Inflectional status, particles, relative reference, phonological intermediacy, and propositional uncertainty belong to one grammatical frame.

subchannels.name: Definition, Substance, and Identity
subchannels.scene_or_process: An entity is identified by its essence and bounded by a verbal definition.
subchannels.active_motifs: logical definition (`ق و ل:B016/m01`); thing's own substance (`ن ف س:B012/m01`); relative identity (`ذ و و:B002/m01`); naming (`س م و:B005/m01`); semantic indication (`ق و ل:B014/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Reference points to an entity, `نفس` supplies its selfsame substance, and definition marks the conceptual limit by which it is known.

subchannels.name: Sign, Evidence, and Visible Meaning
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible mark or verbal indication discloses what would otherwise remain unclear.
subchannels.active_motifs: manifest evidence (`ب ي ن:B004/m01`); signifying statement (`ق و ل:B014/m01`); distinguishing sign (`ع ل م:B002/m01`); prominent marker (`ن ج م:B006/m01`); showing something to another (`ر ء ي:B012/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Mark, prominence, display, and interpretive statement create a semiotic scene in which meaning becomes externally inspectable.

subchannels.name: Misreading, Script, and Metrical Distortion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Written or recited form is corrupted by similar letters or by a defect in poetic measure and rhyme.
subchannels.active_motifs: scribal or reading error (`ص ح ف:B005/m01`); prosodic or rhyme defect (`ق و ي:B002/m01`); written sheet (`ص ح ف:B002/m01`); spoken articulation (`ق و ل:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Graphic resemblance and metrical disruption are parallel failures in the faithful transmission of formal language.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Language makes entities and relations accessible through articulation, naming, grammar, definition, signs, and textual transmission.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The lexical network reaches translation, demonstratives, relative syntax, logical definition, metrical error, and scribal misreading.

parent_channels.name: Dialogic and Public Speech

subchannels.name: Question, Appeal, and Requested Goal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A questioner calls attention to a desired object and asks that it be supplied or explained.
subchannels.active_motifs: asking and requesting (`س ء ل:B001/m01`); requested need (`س ء ل:B002/m01`); attention-getting inquiry (`ر ء ي:B013/m01`); interrogative `ماذا` (`ذ و و:B004/m01`); sought object or will (`ش ي ء:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Attention, interrogative form, desired end, and request combine into a directed appeal.

subchannels.name: Mutual Question and Consultation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two parties exchange questions, deliberate, and negotiate a common course.
subchannels.active_motifs: reciprocal questioning (`س ء ل:B004/m01`); negotiation (`ق و ل:B009/m01`); considered opinion (`ر ء ي:B002/m01`); measured deliberation (`ر س ل:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Reciprocity distinguishes dialogue from one-way request, while opinion and measured pace turn the exchange into consultation.

subchannels.name: Command, Attendance, and Listening
subchannels.scene_or_process: An imperative summons a hearer, urges immediate attention, and is received by listening.
subchannels.active_motifs: imperative summons (`ح ض ر:B013/m01`); exhortation to take hold (`ع ن د:B006/m01`); listening (`ش ي ء:B005/m01`); tongue or articulator (`ق و ل:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Summons, urging, articulated command, and auditory reception supply the roles of speaker, utterance, and responsive hearer.

subchannels.name: Rumor, Reputation, and Circulating News
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repeated speech moves through a community and accumulates as news or reputation.
subchannels.active_motifs: circulating talk (`ق و ل:B007/m01`); spoken mention (`ذ ك ر:B004/m01`); public repute (`ذ ك ر:B007/m01`); favorable renown (`س م و:B008/m01`); embellishing addition (`ز ل ف:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: A statement becomes socially durable through repetition, addition, mention, and the reputation that remains after circulation.

subchannels.name: False Attribution, Backbiting, and Invective
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker appropriates, fabricates, or weaponizes speech against an absent target.
subchannels.active_motifs: false attribution (`ق و ل:B005/m01`); drawing another's words to oneself (`ق و ل:B006/m01`); backbiting (`غ ي ب:B004/m01`); verbal abuse (`ر ج م:B002/m01`); defamatory mention (`ذ ك ر:B004/m02`).
subchannels.synthesis: Fabrication concerns authorship, appropriation concerns ownership of speech, and backbiting and invective direct the resulting words toward social injury.

subchannels.name: Lament and Surprise
subchannels.scene_or_process: Shock, regret, or lack of alternatives produces an involuntary exclamatory cry.
subchannels.active_motifs: lamenting exclamation (`ش ي ء:B007/m01`); repeated lament form (`ش ي ء:B009/m01`); lack of alternative (`ع ن د:B005/m01`); gracious response to an appeal (`ك ر م:B009/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Constrained circumstance supplies the trigger, the exclamation voices distress, and a gracious answer supplies the possible social response.

subchannels.name: Fluency and Speech Blockage
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker ranges from abundant fluent expression to being unable to continue.
subchannels.active_motifs: fluent loquacity (`ق و ل:B003/m01`); speech made difficult (`ج ب ل:B009/m01`); hard, forceful articulation (`ذ ك ر:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Loquacity, articulatory force, and blockage define contrasting capacities within one speech-performance frame.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech acts organize social attention through questioning, consultation, command, circulation, accusation, and emotional address.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The speech channel includes bargaining, rumor, false attribution, backbiting, invective, lament, and fluency blocked by difficulty.

parent_channels.name: Knowledge, Belief, and Deliberation

subchannels.name: Knowledge, Mastery, and Conviction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Evidence is understood so fully that the knower masters the matter and forms a stable judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: knowledge and recognition (`ع ل م:B001/m01`); mastery through complete knowledge (`ق ت ل:B003/m01`); considered judgment (`ر ء ي:B002/m01`); learned wisdom (`ر ب ب:B003/m01`); settled belief (`ء م ن:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Recognition, comprehensive grasp, reflective judgment, learned authority, and assent form a progression from information to conviction.

subchannels.name: Inner Thought and Intention
subchannels.scene_or_process: An unspoken representation is held in the heart as thought, intention, or self-knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: mind and intention (`ن ف س:B013/m01`); inner unuttered speech (`ق و ل:B012/m01`); concealed heart (`ج ن ن:B010/m01`); selfsame identity (`ن ف س:B012/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The mind contains a private saying before articulation, while the hidden heart and reflexive self provide its location and owner.

subchannels.name: Doubt, Guess, and the Unseen
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hidden matter is approached by conjecture, hesitation, and provisional speech rather than certain knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: uncertainty (`غ ي ب:B006/m01`); conjecture about the unseen (`ر ج م:B004/m01`); supposition (`ق و ل:B011/m01`); cautious pace (`ر س ل:B004/m01`); distracted deliberation (`ق س م:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Hidden object, uncertain proposition, guessed account, and slowed judgment define an epistemic scene explicitly opposed to mastery.

subchannels.name: Dream, Sleep, and Imagined Encounter
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sleeper encounters an image without deliberate waking contact and later treats it as a vision.
subchannels.active_motifs: dream vision (`ر ء ي:B003/m01`); unintended encounter (`ب ح ر:B010/m01`); morning sleep (`ص ب ح:B007/m01`); inner image (`ن ف س:B013/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Sleep supplies the setting, accidental encounter the mode, vision the content, and the inner self the place of retention.

subchannels.name: Patience and Deliberate Resolve
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person slows action, tolerates uncertainty, weighs alternatives, and then resolves to proceed.
subchannels.active_motifs: deliberate slowness (`و ء د:B002/m01`); measured conduct (`ر س ل:B004/m01`); respite for thought (`ن ف س:B015/m01`); divided consideration (`ق س م:B006/m01`); letting dispute pass (`س ي ر:B007/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Slowed gait, temporal room, divided attention, and restraint from argument form a coherent discipline of deliberation.

subchannels.name: Doctrine and School
subchannels.scene_or_process: A considered opinion becomes a repeatable doctrinal position associated with a school or method.
subchannels.active_motifs: doctrine or creed (`ق و ل:B013/m01`); reflective opinion (`ر ء ي:B002/m01`); learned authority (`ر ب ب:B003/m01`); method or way (`ذ ه ب:B007/m02`).
subchannels.synthesis: Opinion becomes doctrine when it is formulated as a saying, authorized by learning, and followed as a recognized method.

subchannels.name: Astrological Deliberation
subchannels.scene_or_process: An observer studies stellar positions and turns their pattern into a prediction or plan.
subchannels.active_motifs: reading the stars (`ن ج م:B005/m01`); reflective judgment (`ر ء ي:B002/m01`); conjecture about hidden matters (`ر ج م:B004/m01`); celestial marker (`ن ج م:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Celestial observation supplies the data, judgment supplies interpretation, and conjecture supplies the uncertain inferred outcome.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Mental life moves from perception and inner representation through judgment, trust, doubt, dream, and settled decision.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The network distinguishes knowledge from mastery, belief from calm trust, hidden thought from doctrine, and conjecture from patient deliberation.

parent_channels.name: Worship, Oath, and Supplication

subchannels.name: Worship and Divine Lordship
subchannels.scene_or_process: Worship is directed to the deity recognized as supreme lord and possessor of the throne.
subchannels.active_motifs: worship and deity (`ء ل ه:B001/m01`); divine lordship (`ر ب ب:B001/m01`); throne of sovereignty (`ع ر ش:B001/m01`); exaltation (`س م و:B001/m01`); church attendant (`ش م س:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Deity, worshipper, lordship, throne, and elevation establish a complete vertical relation of worship.

subchannels.name: Oath and Testimony
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker invokes the divine name to bind a statement and establish its credibility.
subchannels.active_motifs: sworn oath (`ق س م:B004/m01`); divine name used in oath (`ء ل ه:B002/m01`); covenant (`ر ب ب:B011/m01`); settled belief (`ء م ن:B002/m01`); articulated assertion (`ق و ل:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Invocation supplies the guarantor, oath binds the speaker, belief supplies assent, and speech carries the testified claim.

subchannels.name: Amen, Petition, and Relief
subchannels.scene_or_process: A petitioner names a need, asks for divine response, and seeks release from distress.
subchannels.active_motifs: `آمين` as request for response (`ء م ن:B003/m01`); divine invocation (`ء ل ه:B002/m01`); requested need (`س ء ل:B002/m01`); devoted concern (`ق و ل:B015/m01`); relief from constriction (`ن ف س:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Need, address, petition, attentive concern, and hoped-for relief form a complete supplicatory exchange.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Ritual speech binds speaker, divine addressee, asserted truth, and requested response.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same frame includes oath, testimony, invocation, the response `آمين`, and urgent prayer for relief.

parent_channels.name: Authority, Stewardship, and Rank

subchannels.name: Throne, Ruler, and Chief
subchannels.scene_or_process: A ruler occupies an elevated seat and exercises speech that carries institutional force.
subchannels.active_motifs: royal throne (`ع ر ش:B001/m01`); master or owner (`ر ب ب:B001/m02`); ruling chief or prince (`ق و ل:B004/m01`); leading men likened to mountains (`ج ب ل:B012/m01`); elevation of rank (`س م و:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Elevated seat, recognized title, commanding speech, and eminent supporters define a political court.

subchannels.name: Stewardship and Preservation of Order
subchannels.scene_or_process: A steward maintains an estate, community, or institution so that its structure remains standing.
subchannels.active_motifs: guardianship and administration (`ق و م:B004/m01`); stability of rule (`ع ر ش:B006/m01`); nurture and repair (`ر ب ب:B002/m01`); authoritative chief (`ق و ل:B004/m01`); structural support (`ق و م:B009/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Care, repair, administration, structural support, and durable authority form one maintenance-oriented model of governance.

subchannels.name: Rank, Proximity, and Established Place
subchannels.scene_or_process: Standing near the ruler expresses favor, fixed rank, and secure institutional position.
subchannels.active_motifs: approach (`ز ل ف:B001/m01`); favored nearness (`ز ل ف:B002/m01`); proximity (`ع ن د:B004/m01`); established status (`م ك ن:B004/m01`); elevated reputation (`س م و:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Nearness is not only spatial: it becomes the visible arrangement of favor, rank, and authority.

subchannels.name: Delegate, Substitute, and Adjudicated Dispute
subchannels.scene_or_process: An agent stands in for another, guarantees performance, and may represent a party in a contested claim.
subchannels.active_motifs: agent or guarantor (`ج ر ي:B003/m01`); commissioned messenger (`ر س ل:B002/m01`); substitution (`ق و م:B007/m01`); attached representative (`ص ح ب:B004/m01`); litigated contest (`ح ض ر:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Delegation, substitution, attachment, guarantee, and formal contest specify the roles of representation before authority.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Social order is maintained through sovereignty, care of an entrusted domain, recognized rank, delegation, and adjudication.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 81:20-21 `ذي قوة عند ذي العرش مكين مطاع أمين` and 81:29 `رب`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The authority channel moves from throne and lordship to village rulers, substitutes, guarantors, and litigants before a judge.

parent_channels.name: Agency, Capacity, and Constraint

subchannels.name: Will, Capacity, and Undertaking
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person wills an act, has the practical ability to perform it, and rises to undertake it.
subchannels.active_motifs: volition (`ش ي ء:B001/m01`); capability (`ط و ع:B003/m01`); empowerment (`م ك ن:B005/m01`); resolve to rise (`ق و م:B003/m01`); effort to become capable (`ط و ع:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Intention, feasibility, enabling conditions, effort, and initiation form a complete model of effective agency.

subchannels.name: Obedience and Easy Compliance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A command is accepted, followed, and made easy by trust and compatible disposition.
subchannels.active_motifs: obedience (`ط و ع:B001/m01`); mutual agreement (`ط و ع:B002/m01`); docile following (`ص ح ب:B003/m01`); calm trust (`ء م ن:B001/m01`); easy familiarity (`ر س ل:B007/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Compliance is shown not as force but as agreement, tractability, trust, and ease in following.

subchannels.name: Compulsion, Taming, and Forced Readiness
subchannels.scene_or_process: Resistance is broken through pressure until a person or animal becomes usable and compliant.
subchannels.active_motifs: forcing another to act (`ج ب ل:B010/m01`); taming through subjugation (`ق ت ل:B002/m01`); imposed effort (`ط و ع:B004/m01`); restive disposition (`ش م س:B002/m01`); institutional control (`ق و ل:B010/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Force, training, imposed effort, and controlling judgment trace the conversion of resistance into constrained performance.

subchannels.name: Straightness, Deviation, and Resistance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A path or will is measured against a straight norm and may align with it, bend away, or knowingly resist.
subchannels.active_motifs: upright alignment (`ق و م:B008/m01`); obstinate deviation (`ع ن د:B001/m01`); crooked opposition (`ش ط ن:B003/m01`); separation from the line (`ب ي ن:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Straightness is relational: it becomes visible through the contrasting motions of bending, parting, and deliberate refusal.

subchannels.name: Voluntary Good and Self-Commitment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person freely offers good, steels the self, and accepts hardship for a chosen end.
subchannels.active_motifs: voluntary service (`ط و ع:B005/m01`); generosity (`ك ر م:B001/m02`); freely given welfare (`ن ش ر:B010/m01`); inner courage (`ن ف س:B014/m02`); self-endangerment (`ق ت ل:B012/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Free choice, benefaction, strength of character, and willingness to bear danger distinguish committed action from compelled action.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Action depends on willing, being able, submitting, resisting, being compelled, or voluntarily taking on an obligation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Agency appears as a graded field ranging from easy compliance and capability to taming, coercion, moral deviation, and courageous self-commitment.

parent_channels.name: Social Bonds, Household, and Community

subchannels.name: Companionship and Protective Accompaniment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Companions remain together, protect one another, and develop familiar mutual attachment.
subchannels.active_motifs: companionship (`ص ح ب:B001/m01`); protection through accompaniment (`ص ح ب:B002/m01`); affectionate associate (`س ج ر:B003/m01`); social intercourse (`ع ش ر:B012/m01`); ease and familiarity (`ر س ل:B007/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Presence, protection, affection, habitual association, and ease create a durable companionship frame.

subchannels.name: Pairing and Affiliated Peers
subchannels.scene_or_process: Individuals or objects are joined as counterparts, associates, or members of the same type.
subchannels.active_motifs: paired counterpart (`ز و ج:B001/m01`); active pairing (`ز و ج:B003/m01`); similar peers (`ز و ج:B005/m01`); type or class (`ز و ج:B004/m01`); mutual correspondence (`ر س ل:B008/m01`); compatible attachment (`ص ح ب:B004/m01`); keeping pace (`ج ر ي:B007/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Pair, pairing act, peer class, attachment, and parallel motion define association without requiring marriage.

subchannels.name: Marriage, Courtship, and Divorce
subchannels.scene_or_process: A spouse relation is formed, approached through courtship, and may be ended by a separation that blocks return.
subchannels.active_motifs: marital spouse (`ز و ج:B002/m01`); widow or divorcee receiving suitors (`ر س ل:B009/m01`); woman's face in courtship (`ز ل ف:B007/m01`); coquettish approach (`ق ت ل:B004/m01`); irrevocable divorce (`ب ي ن:B012/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Potential partner, courtship behavior, visible face, marital bond, and final separation form a complete household transition.

subchannels.name: Caregiver, Stepchild, and Adult Son
subchannels.scene_or_process: A child moves from gestation and care under a guardian to adult companionship with a parent.
subchannels.active_motifs: stepchild and caregiver (`ر ب ب:B005/m01`); fetus or child in the womb (`ج ن ن:B007/m01`); childbirth (`ن ف س:B005/m01`); son becoming an adult companion (`ص ح ب:B005/m01`); nurture to completion (`ر ب ب:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Gestation, birth, guardianship, nurture, and adult companionship describe a continuous intergenerational relation.

subchannels.name: Gathering, Crowd, and Clan
subchannels.scene_or_process: Individuals are driven together into a crowd, community, clan, or mobilized assembly.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathering toward a destination (`ح ش ر:B001/m01`); mass of common people (`ج ن ن:B013/m01`); multitude (`ج ب ل:B002/m01`); clan or tribe (`ع ش ر:B013/m01`); community of people (`ق و م:B001/m01`); present group (`ح ض ر:B007/m01`); followers (`ذ ن ب:B003/m01`); confederated groups (`ر ب ب:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Mass, lineage, presence, and directed assembly distinguish an organized community from an accidental plurality.

subchannels.name: Settlement and Abandonment
subchannels.scene_or_process: People establish a village or stable residence, then its loss of inhabitants and use turns it into waste.
subchannels.active_motifs: settled life (`ح ض ر:B002/m01`); residence (`ق و م:B006/m01`); place of being (`م ك ن:B003/m01`); village between desert and cultivation (`ز ل ف:B005/m01`); district of villages (`ك و ر:B005/m01`); remaining in a place (`ع ر ش:B012/m01`); abandonment (`ع ط ل:B001/m01`); desolate country (`و ح ش:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Settlement is built from place, residence, village network, and continuity; abandonment reverses the same roles by removing inhabitant and use.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: People become socially organized through companionship, pairing, marriage, care, kinship, collective gathering, and residence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The social network includes widow courtship, irrevocable divorce, stepchildren, adult sons, clans, settled villages, and abandoned homes.

parent_channels.name: Value, Allocation, and Exchange

subchannels.name: Market Price and Bargaining
subchannels.scene_or_process: A market becomes active, a price is established, and parties negotiate over a sale.
subchannels.active_motifs: market price (`س ع ر:B003/m01`); valuation (`ق و م:B010/m01`); thriving market (`ق و م:B018/m01`); negotiation (`ق و ل:B009/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Market activity, valuation, demand, and verbal negotiation form one exchange mechanism.

subchannels.name: Co-Owned Property and Auction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Co-owners bid until one buys out the others and becomes the sole holder.
subchannels.active_motifs: competitive purchase of a shared asset (`ق و ي:B004/m01`); controlling judgment (`ق و ل:B010/m01`); substitution of one holder for another (`ق و م:B007/m01`); apportioned entitlement (`ذ ن ب:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Shared ownership, appraisal, escalating bid, transfer, and substitution define a specific property transaction.

subchannels.name: Division, Tithe, and Tax
subchannels.scene_or_process: Property is partitioned into shares and a tenth is removed as an assessed due.
subchannels.active_motifs: division into portions (`ق س م:B003/m01`); allotted share (`ذ ن ب:B006/m01`); one tenth (`ع ش ر:B003/m01`); collection of the tenth (`ع ش ر:B004/m01`); loss of property under scarcity (`ح ش ر:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Partition establishes ownership, the tenth specifies the rate, and collection turns the abstract share into a fiscal obligation.

subchannels.name: Gift, Reward, and Welfare
subchannels.scene_or_process: A benefit is given freely or in expectation of reciprocation and becomes continuing welfare.
subchannels.active_motifs: gift seeking recompense (`ك ر م:B008/m01`); gracious assent (`ك ر م:B009/m01`); generosity (`ن ش ر:B010/m01`); easy giving (`ر س ل:B010/m01`); continuing provision (`ج ر ي:B006/m01`); relief from need (`ن ف س:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Gift, response, continuity, ease, and relief distinguish reciprocal benefaction from impersonal transfer.

subchannels.name: Preciousness, Rival Desire, and Hoarding
subchannels.scene_or_process: A scarce object attracts competition and is guarded, withheld, or favored because of its value.
subchannels.active_motifs: coveted valuable (`ن ف س:B010/m01`); withholding (`ض ن ن:B001/m01`); precious favorite (`ض ن ن:B002/m01`); defensive miserliness (`ش م س:B006/m01`); beloved valuable (`ك ر م:B010/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Value generates desire; desire generates competition; and competition explains both protective withholding and the status of the favored object.

subchannels.name: Gambling Lot and Arrow Case
subchannels.scene_or_process: Marked arrows are gathered, drawn, and used to assign a wagered share.
subchannels.active_motifs: fifth gambling arrow (`ن ف س:B016/m01`); case holding gaming arrows (`ر ب ب:B010/m01`); apportioned share (`ق س م:B003/m01`); grouped pieces (`ع ش ر:B009/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Container, marked lot, drawing procedure, and allocated portion form a complete gaming mechanism.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Goods and benefits are evaluated, divided, exchanged, gifted, withheld, or risked under shared rules.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The network reconstructs market pricing, co-owner auctions, tithes, reciprocal gifts, hoarding, and a specific gambling lot.

parent_channels.name: Honor, Character, and Esteem

subchannels.name: Honor and Enduring Repute
subchannels.scene_or_process: Excellence produces praise that circulates and remains as a person's public name.
subchannels.active_motifs: honorable character (`ك ر م:B001/m01`); renowned mention (`ذ ك ر:B007/m01`); favorable repute (`س م و:B008/m01`); surpassing excellence (`ء ف ق:B003/m01`); public circulation (`ق و ل:B007/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Excellence becomes social honor when it is voiced, circulated, and retained as enduring repute.

subchannels.name: Rivalry and Boasting
subchannels.scene_or_process: Competitors compare generosity or status and attempt to surpass one another.
subchannels.active_motifs: contest in generosity (`ك ر م:B006/m01`); competitive matching (`س م و:B007/m01`); rivalry over a valued object (`ن ف س:B010/m02`); public display (`ر ء ي:B005/m01`); running abreast (`ج ر ي:B007/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Valued stakes, comparison, matched performance, and attempted superiority turn honor into an active contest.

subchannels.name: Dignity, Ambition, and Courage
subchannels.scene_or_process: Inner stature supports high aspiration and the courage to bear difficult action.
subchannels.active_motifs: dignity and aspiration (`ن ف س:B014/m01`); tightly held need or ambition (`ر ب ب:B016/m01`); gathered strength (`ق و ي:B001/m01`); robust constitution (`ج ب ل:B003/m01`); self-endangering courage (`ق ت ل:B012/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Character is embodied as inner magnitude, concentrated need, physical strength, and readiness to act under danger.

subchannels.name: Shamelessness, Hostility, and Dishonor
subchannels.scene_or_process: Loss of restraint appears as brazenness, declared hostility, and abusive speech.
subchannels.active_motifs: shamelessness (`ج ح م:B005/m01`); open hostility (`ش م س:B003/m01`); verbal abuse (`ر ج م:B002/m01`); ugly disposition (`ش ط ن:B004/m02`); defamatory speech (`ق و ل:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Insolence removes social restraint, hostility directs it toward an opponent, and invective gives the dishonor verbal form.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Persons and things are socially evaluated through reputation, generosity, rivalry, dignity, courage, and their negative reversals.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Honor is not only praise; it also drives competitive boasting, guarded preciousness, ambition, shamelessness, and verbal attack.

parent_channels.name: Embodied Perception and Form

subchannels.name: Sight, Gaze, and Farsight
subchannels.scene_or_process: An eye fixes and sustains attention on a distant visible object.
subchannels.active_motifs: visual perception (`ر ء ي:B001/m01`); prolonged gaze (`ك د ر:B006/m01`); farsight (`ش ي ء:B003/m01`); glaring or protruding eye (`ج ح م:B003/m01`); visible elevated figure (`س م و:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Visual object, distance, ocular intensity, and sustained attention form a coherent perception scene.

subchannels.name: Evil Eye and Preserved Blind Eye
subchannels.scene_or_process: A gaze harms another, while an eye may remain physically present after losing sight.
subchannels.active_motifs: injurious eye (`ن ف س:B003/m01`); intact but blind eye (`ق و م:B021/m01`); visual shock (`ذ ه ب:B003/m01`); red, glaring eye (`ج ح م:B003/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Harmful seeing and sightless ocular persistence create a marked contrast between the social force of gaze and the organ's failed function.

subchannels.name: Mirror, Beauty, Complexion, and Stature
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body is viewed and evaluated through reflected appearance, facial proportion, color, and height.
subchannels.active_motifs: mirror and visible appearance (`ر ء ي:B006/m01`); well-proportioned face (`ق س م:B001/m01`); full and handsome body (`ع ط ل:B004/m01`); bodily stature (`ق و م:B011/m01`); ruddy beauty (`ص ب ح:B006/m02`).
subchannels.synthesis: Reflection supplies the viewing device, while proportion, stature, and complexion supply the dimensions of embodied beauty.

subchannels.name: Color, Redness, and Clouding
subchannels.scene_or_process: A surface color shifts through redness, yellowing, blackness, and turbidity.
subchannels.active_motifs: red-gray complexion (`ص ب ح:B006/m01`); red admixture (`س ج ر:B004/m01`); reddish coat (`ص ح ب:B008/m01`); red shading toward yellow (`ذ ه ب:B004/m01`); dark complexion (`س ع ر:B008/m01`); murky color (`ك د ر:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs describe color as layered admixture and transition rather than as isolated labels.

subchannels.name: Breath, Lung, Nose, and Chest
subchannels.scene_or_process: Breath exits through the nose from a chest whose lungs and ribs sustain respiration.
subchannels.active_motifs: exhaled breath (`ن ف س:B001/m01`); lung and lung ailment (`ر ء ي:B009/m01`); nasal contraction (`خ ن س:B003/m01`); chest and rib bones (`ج ن ن:B016/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Chest structure, lung, nasal passage, and moving breath form a single respiratory anatomy.

subchannels.name: Body Mass, Skeleton, and Sinew
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bodily form is built from compact mass, swollen abdomen, chest bones, hip joint, and tensioned nerves.
subchannels.active_motifs: thick bodily build (`ج ب ل:B003/m01`); enlarged abdomen (`ب ح ر:B013/m01`); swollen flanks (`ح ش ر:B005/m01`); chest bones (`ج ن ن:B016/m01`); compact strong body (`ك د ر:B005/m01`); hip joint (`ك ر م:B007/m01`); spread sinews (`ن ش ر:B007/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: External mass and internal articulation are linked through bones, joint, and sinew, giving a structured account of bodily robustness.

subchannels.name: Wasting Disease, Lameness, and Mange
subchannels.scene_or_process: An animal or person loses flesh and mobility as systemic illness spreads into limbs and skin.
subchannels.active_motifs: wasting disease (`ب ح ر:B011/m01`); limb disease in sheep (`ق و م:B020/m01`); onset of mange (`س ع ر:B005/m01`); pain fixed in an organ (`ق و م:B019/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Loss of flesh, painful organ, impaired legs, and spreading skin disease form a coherent wasting-illness scene.

subchannels.name: Thirst, Acute Crisis, and Cough
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dehydration or acute illness reaches a crisis marked by unrelieved thirst and a sharp respiratory attack.
subchannels.active_motifs: unquenched thirst (`ب ح ر:B014/m01`); acute medical crisis (`ب ح ر:B012/m01`); sharp cough (`س ع ر:B010/m01`); empty stomach (`و ح ش:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Lack of replenishment, bodily emptiness, crisis, and cough define an acute breakdown distinct from chronic wasting.

subchannels.name: Smell, Fragrance, and Perfumed Wash
subchannels.scene_or_process: A scented substance is applied or released, its fragrance spreads, and a person detects it by smell.
subchannels.active_motifs: smelling (`ع س ع س:B005/m01`); spreading fragrance (`ن ش ر:B003/m01`); perfumed wash or scent (`ض ن ن:B003/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Scented material, diffusion through air, and sensory detection supply object, process, and perceiver.

subchannels.name: Terror, Release, and Security
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sudden visual shock produces fear, which then recedes as constriction is relieved and safety returns.
subchannels.active_motifs: bewildered fear (`ب ح ر:B008/m01`); shock at seeing gold (`ذ ه ب:B003/m01`); fear falling away (`ك ش ط:B004/m01`); relief from distress (`ن ف س:B002/m01`); restored security (`ء م ن:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Perceptual trigger, fear state, release, and security form a complete affective transition.

subchannels.name: Admiration and Gracious Approval
subchannels.scene_or_process: A pleasing appearance elicits delight and an approving social response.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible comeliness (`ر ء ي:B006/m02`); delight and admiration (`ش ي ء:B004/m01`); gracious assent (`ك ر م:B009/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Attractive appearance supplies the object, delight the affect, and gracious assent its expressed response.

subchannels.name: Anatomical Clefts and Surfaces
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bodily surfaces are distinguished by slits, separated parts, ridges, and smooth hairless areas.
subchannels.active_motifs: cleft upper lip (`ع ل م:B004/m01`); slit ear (`ب ح ر:B003/m01`); limb separated from its neighbor (`ب ي ن:B008/m01`); neck and foot ridges (`ع ر ش:B007/m01`); smooth hairless surface (`ك ن س:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Cleft, separation, ridge, and smooth plane form a precise morphology of anatomical boundaries.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The body senses and displays the world through eye, breath, smell, color, stature, tissue, and disease.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The body channel includes evil eye, intact but blind eye, lung and nostril, complexion, obesity, chest bones, sinews, cleft lip, wasting disease, mange, and cough.

parent_channels.name: Reproduction and Life Stages

subchannels.name: Embryo, Afterbirth, and Childbirth
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fetus remains hidden, is born, and leaves afterbirth and postpartum material.
subchannels.active_motifs: fetus in the womb (`ج ن ن:B007/m01`); afterbirth and wound discharge (`ح ض ر:B008/m01`); childbirth and lochia (`ن ف س:B005/m01`); caregiver for the child (`ر ب ب:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Hidden fetus, delivery, afterbirth, postpartum state, and caregiver form a complete human birth scene.

subchannels.name: Pregnant Camel or Ewe Near Delivery
subchannels.scene_or_process: A heavily pregnant animal shows visible signs, remains at rest, and approaches parturition.
subchannels.active_motifs: ten-month pregnant camel (`ع ش ر:B007/m01`); visible pregnancy (`ر ء ي:B010/m01`); newly delivered ewe (`ر ب ب:B009/m01`); camel remaining at its resting place (`ص ب ح:B008/m01`); thickened bodily condition (`ك د ر:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Duration, visible body change, restricted movement, and nearness to birth specify the livestock state named at the surface.

subchannels.name: Maternal Call and Newborn Care
subchannels.scene_or_process: A mother calls after her young while attendants maintain the newborn and postpartum animal.
subchannels.active_motifs: prolonged maternal cry (`س ج ر:B007/m01`); postpartum ewe kept close (`ر ب ب:B009/m01`); nurture and completion (`ر ب ب:B002/m01`); continuing milk (`ر س ل:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Maternal voice, proximity, milk, posture, and care create a post-birth livestock scene.

subchannels.name: Youth, Maiden, and Adult Child
subchannels.scene_or_process: Life advances from the first stage of youth through maidenhood to an adult child's companionship.
subchannels.active_motifs: beginning of youth (`ج ن ن:B014/m01`); young woman (`ج ر ي:B004/m01`); youthful full body (`ك د ر:B005/m02`); beautiful mature form (`ع ط ل:B004/m01`); son become companion (`ص ح ب:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Onset, adolescent form, maiden status, maturation, and adult companionship define successive social and bodily stages.

subchannels.name: Egg, Clutch, and Emerging Brood
subchannels.scene_or_process: Reptile or small-animal eggs are held in a clutch until the young emerge.
subchannels.active_motifs: lizard eggs (`م ك ن:B001/m01`); chick leaving the egg (`ق و ي:B006/m01`); small ground creatures (`ح ش ر:B004/m01`); reptile (`ج ن ن:B012/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Egg container, clutch fauna, reptile parent, and emerging young form a reproductive scene distinct from human and livestock birth.

subchannels.name: Mating Display and Repeated Bray
subchannels.scene_or_process: A male animal mounts, raises its head, and accompanies the display with repeated calls.
subchannels.active_motifs: mounting stallion (`س م و:B003/m01`); donkey mating posture (`ع ر ش:B009/m01`); repeated braying (`ع ش ر:B008/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Mounting, raised posture, and repeated vocalization form a discrete reproductive display.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Life moves through conception, gestation, birth, maternal care, youth, maturity, and species reproduction.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The lexical imagery specifies livestock pregnancy, afterbirth, maternal calls, adolescent maidens, adult sons, reptile eggs, and emerging chicks.

parent_channels.name: Mortality, Burial, and Return

subchannels.name: Killing and Lifeblood
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wounding releases the blood that sustains life, and its loss produces death.
subchannels.active_motifs: killing (`ق ت ل:B001/m01`); lifeblood (`ن ف س:B004/m01`); uncontrolled blood flow (`ع ن د:B003/m01`); bodily support lost with blood (`ق و م:B009/m02`).
subchannels.synthesis: Act, wound outcome, flowing blood, and collapse of bodily support form a causal mortality scene.

subchannels.name: Live Burial under Earth
subchannels.scene_or_process: A living child is weighed down and hidden beneath earth until life is extinguished.
subchannels.active_motifs: live burial under soil (`و ء د:B001/m01`); covering a body (`ج ن ن:B009/m01`); burial in a grave (`غ ي ب:B009/m01`); killing (`ق ت ل:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Weight, covering, disappearance into the grave, and death preserve the specific violence of burial alive.

subchannels.name: Grave, Shroud, and Cairn
subchannels.scene_or_process: The dead body is wrapped, placed in a grave, and marked or enclosed by gathered stones.
subchannels.active_motifs: shrouding and grave (`ج ن ن:B009/m01`); interment (`غ ي ب:B009/m01`); grave cairn (`ر ج م:B005/m01`); removal from sight (`غ ي ب:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Covering, subterranean placement, stone marker, and visual absence describe the material organization of burial.

subchannels.name: Resurrection and Final Gathering
subchannels.scene_or_process: The dead are restored to life and assembled for a final standing.
subchannels.active_motifs: reviving the dead (`ن ش ر:B002/m01`); resurrection and standing (`ق و م:B013/m01`); gathering toward judgment (`ح ش ر:B001/m01`); life restored (`ن ف س:B011/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Revival supplies renewed life, gathering supplies collective movement, and standing supplies the final state.

subchannels.name: Self-Sacrifice and Mortal Peril
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person deliberately places the self where death or severe harm is likely.
subchannels.active_motifs: casting oneself into danger (`ق ت ل:B012/m01`); exposing another to killing (`ق ت ل:B005/m01`); living self at risk (`ن ف س:B011/m01`); courage under danger (`ن ف س:B014/m02`).
subchannels.synthesis: Risk, exposure, living subject, and resolve distinguish sacrifice from death suffered without agency.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Life is lost, covered in earth, held in a grave, and imagined as restored or gathered again.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The sequence distinguishes lifeblood loss, live burial, grave architecture, resurrection, and deliberate self-exposure to death.

parent_channels.name: Fire, Conflict, and Intensification

subchannels.name: Stoked Blaze
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fuel is ignited, stirred, and intensified into a fierce enclosed fire.
subchannels.active_motifs: blazing fire (`ج ح م:B001/m01`); kindling and stoking (`س ج ر:B005/m01`); ignition and flame (`س ع ر:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Fire source, fuel operation, and resulting blaze form the core combustion scene.

subchannels.name: Battle as Kindled Fire
subchannels.scene_or_process: Opposing groups kindle conflict until it becomes lethal combat.
subchannels.active_motifs: raging battle (`ج ح م:B002/m01`); war set alight (`س ع ر:B002/m01`); mutual combat (`ق ت ل:B011/m01`); matched enemy (`ق ت ل:B008/m01`); armed resistance (`ق و م:B014/m01`); defender of the group (`ر ج م:B007/m01`); truce (`ق س م:B008/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Ignition supplies the causal metaphor, while opposed parties, lethal engagement, resistance, and defense complete the battle scene.

subchannels.name: Anger and Open Hostility
subchannels.scene_or_process: Internal heat rises into the face and becomes visible antagonism toward another.
subchannels.active_motifs: face inflamed by anger (`ج ح م:B004/m01`); declared hostility (`ش م س:B003/m01`); face-to-face opposition (`ر ء ي:B004/m01`); harsh speech (`ر ج م:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Heat becomes facial sign, sign becomes confrontation, and confrontation becomes verbal aggression.

subchannels.name: Oven and Peak Heat
subchannels.scene_or_process: Enclosed or seasonal heat reaches a peak in an earth oven, at midday, or on an extreme summer day.
subchannels.active_motifs: earth-cut oven (`س ع ر:B009/m01`); midday heat (`ق س م:B002/m01`); extreme summer day (`ب ح ر:B012/m02`); length or intensity (`س ع ر:B011/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Oven enclosure, solar timing, intensity, and crisis align around heat reaching a decisive threshold.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Heat intensifies matter, emotion, and social opposition until it becomes blaze, battle, or anger.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Fire vocabulary crosses into warfare, facial anger, hostility, furnace heat, and extreme seasonal heat without erasing the distinct scenes.

parent_channels.name: Supernatural Affliction and Protection

subchannels.name: Madness and Possession
subchannels.scene_or_process: Mind and behavior are overwhelmed by madness, passion, or an afflicting hidden presence.
subchannels.active_motifs: loss of reason (`ج ن ن:B006/m01`); overpowering love or jinn (`ق ت ل:B006/m01`); affliction coming upon a person (`ح ض ر:B009/m01`); madness and torment (`س ع ر:B004/m01`); hidden heart (`ج ن ن:B010/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Hidden source, arrival of affliction, overwhelmed heart, mental derangement, and suffering form one possession-like process.

subchannels.name: Jinn, Apparition, and Divination
subchannels.scene_or_process: A concealed being appears to a person and supplies uncanny sight, omen, or counsel.
subchannels.active_motifs: hidden jinn (`ج ن ن:B005/m01`); familiar apparition (`ر ء ي:B008/m01`); concealed heart or secret (`ج ن ن:B010/m01`); wild separation from human society (`و ح ش:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Hidden being, apparition, secret disclosure, and estrangement from ordinary society define an encounter frame distinct from madness itself.

subchannels.name: Rebel, Devil, and Expulsion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A rebellious being is identified, rejected, cursed, and driven away.
subchannels.active_motifs: rebellious devil (`ش ط ن:B004/m01`); curse and expulsion (`ر ج م:B003/m01`); retreat into hiding (`خ ن س:B001/m01`); jinn identity (`ج ن ن:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Rebellion supplies the offense, naming identifies the agent, and curse, expulsion, and retreat supply the outcome.

subchannels.name: Exorcistic Cure and Protective Shield
subchannels.scene_or_process: A spoken or applied treatment removes affliction while a shield protects against its return.
subchannels.active_motifs: curative charm (`ن ش ر:B008/m01`); protective shield (`ج ن ن:B008/m01`); relief from distress (`ن ف س:B002/m01`); restored security (`ء م ن:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Treatment acts on the affliction, relief marks its removal, and shield plus security define continuing protection.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Hidden beings or forces disturb mind and body, while expulsion, shielding, and ritual treatment restore safety.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The network differentiates madness, jinn apparition, demonic rebellion, and a concrete exorcistic treatment rather than treating them as one supernatural label.

parent_channels.name: Time, Count, and Measure

subchannels.name: Ten, Tenth, and Grouped Count
subchannels.scene_or_process: Units are counted to ten, completed by a tenth member, or arranged in groups of ten.
subchannels.active_motifs: number ten (`ع ش ر:B001/m01`); completing nine with a tenth (`ع ش ر:B002/m01`); one-tenth fraction (`ع ش ر:B003/m01`); groups of ten (`ع ش ر:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Cardinal number, completion, fraction, and grouped distribution preserve distinct operations within one decimal scheme.

subchannels.name: Night Hours and Calendar Day
subchannels.scene_or_process: Time is located by early night segments, the current night, morning appointment, and the tenth day of a month.
subchannels.active_motifs: early portions of night (`ز ل ف:B003/m01`); present night (`ل ي ل:B003/m01`); specified morning (`ص ب ح:B009/m01`); tenth day of Muharram (`ع ش ر:B011/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Relative night, segmented night, fixed morning, and named calendar day create a layered system of temporal deixis.

subchannels.name: Watering Interval and Gestational Duration
subchannels.scene_or_process: Herd life is scheduled by the interval between watering visits and by a ten-month pregnancy.
subchannels.active_motifs: tenth-day watering cycle (`ع ش ر:B006/m01`); return to water (`ح ض ر:B003/m01`); scheduled morning (`ص ب ح:B009/m01`); ten-month pregnancy (`ع ش ر:B007/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Recurrent water access and gestational duration use the same counted interval to organize pastoral time.

subchannels.name: Length, Depth, and Equal Measure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A physical span or quantity is established by length, depth, rope, scale, and balanced weight.
subchannels.active_motifs: ten-cubit length (`ع ش ر:B010/m01`); extended intensity or length (`س ع ر:B011/m01`); deep interval (`ب ي ن:B006/m01`); long rope (`ش ط ن:B002/m01`); regional measure (`ذ ه ب:B008/m01`); equal weight (`ق و م:B015/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Linear extent, depth, measuring cord, named unit, and balanced weight form a coherent metrological scene.

subchannels.name: Temporal Becoming and Midday
subchannels.scene_or_process: A state begins, changes, and reaches a temporally marked point such as noon.
subchannels.active_motifs: time during an action (`ب ي ن:B010/m01`); becoming a new state (`ص ب ح:B010/m01`); first onset (`ج ن ن:B014/m02`); sharp beginning (`س ع ر:B010/m02`); solar noon (`ق و م:B017/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Inception, transition, interval, and noon establish a temporal process with a beginning, changing state, and marked culmination.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Events and objects are ordered by count, calendrical position, interval, duration, and measured extent.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The numerical root develops into tithes, ten-at-a-time grouping, a watering cycle, ten-cubit length, the tenth day, and gestational duration.

parent_channels.name: S1. Serpent and Grotesque Form
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A snake is represented through a frightening, distorted appearance likened to a demonic head.
parent_channels.active_motifs: serpent (`ج ن ن:B012/m01`); grotesque snake-like form (`ش ط ن:B005/m01`); distorted constitution (`ج ب ل:B004/m01`); facial disfigurement (`ش ي ء:B002/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Species, frightening comparison, malformed constitution, and visible distortion form a zoological-grotesque scene distinct from jinn or possession.

parent_channels.name: S2. Club for the Game of Qilla
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A purpose-made wooden club is used to strike the playing piece in the game of `قلة`.
parent_channels.active_motifs: club used in the game of `قلة` (`ق و ل:B008/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The named implement and its prescribed striking function define a recreation scene.

parent_channels.name: S3. Hive Enclosure
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Bees occupy a purpose-built woven enclosure in which honeycomb accumulates.
parent_channels.active_motifs: hive or bee enclosure containing honeycomb (`ك و ر:B006/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: A purpose-built enclosure houses the colony and the honeycomb it accumulates.

parent_channels.name: S4. Harness, Howdah, and Drape
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A riding animal carries a saddle or howdah secured and covered by fitted textile equipment.
parent_channels.active_motifs: saddle and pack frame (`ك و ر:B004/m01`); woman's howdah (`ع ر ش:B005/m01`); howdah drape (`ز و ج:B006/m01`); leather strap (`س ي ر:B003/m01`); collar or yoke (`س ج ر:B009/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Frame, riding enclosure, covering textile, fastening strap, and collar form a self-contained transport-equipment assembly.

parent_channels.name: S5. Layered Heap and Bodily Fall
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A body or mass falls compactly and accumulates in overlapping layers.
parent_channels.active_motifs: compact falling body (`ك و ر:B002/m01`); piled layers (`ر ج م:B010/m01`); wrestlers heaped together (`ك و ر:B012/m01`); scattered downward rush (`ك د ر:B004/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Fall, compactness, overlap, and accumulation define a mechanical heap distinct from burial, masonry, or textile bundling.

parent_channels.name: S6. Omentum and Stored Fat
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A sheet of internal fat lies over the abdominal organs as a distinct anatomical material.
parent_channels.synthesis: The omentum is an internal fatty covering with a definite material, location, and anatomical function.

parent_channels.name: S7. Arrow Point and Fletching
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A light projectile is assembled from a sharpened profile, short shaft, and leading feathers.
parent_channels.active_motifs: slender sharpened point or fletching (`ح ش ر:B006/m01`); short arrow (`ر س ل:B011/m01`); primary flight feathers (`ع ش ر:B017/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Point, shaft, and feathering provide the functional components of one projectile.
